definitions.gloss: long strides; walking with wide steps
definitions.explanation: A long step taken with the legs spread wide. Mostly used in {大股|おおまた}で{歩|ある}く, to walk with long strides, a confident or hurried gait. The opposite is {小股|こまた}, short steps.

examples.japanese: {大股|おおまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

examples.english: He strode out of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しそうだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大股|おおまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{急|いそ}いだ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I hurried to the station with long strides.

notes:
{大|おお} (big) + {股|また} (crotch; the space between the legs). Usually describes a gait that looks confident, impatient or angry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大股|おおまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk with long strides
- {大股|おおまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: to stride up to someone
- {大股|おおまた}{開|びら}き: legs spread wide (sitting or standing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小股|こまた}: short, mincing steps ({小股|こまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧)
- ⟦{早足|はやあし}→早足：21118_hayaashi⟧: a quick pace; speed, not the length of the step
